title: Anti-cancer activity elucidation of geissolosimine as an MDM2-p53 interaction inhibitor: An in-silico study.
authors: Al-Amin, Md; Tanjin, Rehnuma; Karim, Md Rasul; Etee, Jannatul Mawa; Siddika, Ayesha; Akter, Nafisa; Uddin, Md Helal; Mahmud, Ratul; Saffat, Tasfia; Hossen, Md Faruk; Mowlee, Samira Idris; Rafa, Elmu Kabir; Akter, Sumi
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过虚拟筛选和分子模拟探究生物碱抑制MDM2-p53蛋白-蛋白相互作用，对象为蛋白-蛋白而非蛋白-DNA互作，方法虽含对接与MD但与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: For cancer treatment, Inhibition of murine double minute (MDM2) & p53 interaction is considered an attractive therapeutic approach. In this study, we performed an integrated virtual screening (i.e., QSAR, structural similarity, molecular docking, and molecular dynamic simulation) on the in-house building alkaloids library. Geissolosimine (i.e., an indole alkaloid) was predicted as a potential inhibitor for MDM2-p53 interaction. The predicted pIC50 value of Geissolosimine, was 7.013 M. Moreover, Geissolosimine showed 0.62% structural similarity to 'SAR405838' (i.e., a clinical trial inhibitor for MDM2-p53 interaction inhibition); and a docking score of -10.9 kcal/mol that was higher than the 'SAR405838'.100 ns molecular dynamics simulation (MDS) was performed to validate the docking result and it exhibited better binding stability to MDM2. The pharmacokinetic & drug-likeness analysis suggested that Geissolosimine had potential to be a drug-like compound. However, in vitro & in vivo assays will be required to validate this study.
abstract_zh: 对于癌症治疗，抑制鼠双微体（MDM2）与p53的相互作用被认为是一种有吸引力的治疗策略。在本研究中，我们对内部构建的生物碱库进行了整合虚拟筛选（即QSAR、结构相似性、分子对接和分子动力学模拟）。预测Geissolosimine（一种吲哚生物碱）为MDM2-p53相互作用的潜在抑制剂。Geissolosimine的预测pIC50值为7.013 M。此外，Geissolosimine与‘SAR405838’（一种用于MDM2-p53相互作用抑制的临床试验抑制剂）显示出0.62%的结构相似性；其对接分数为-10.9 kcal/mol，高于‘SAR405838’。进行了100 ns的分子动力学模拟（MDS）以验证对接结果，并显示出与MDM2更好的结合稳定性。药代动力学和类药性分析表明，Geissolosimine具有成为类药化合物的潜力。然而，需要体外和体内实验来验证本研究。
